payload.title: EI maternity claim processed
payload.summary: your EI maternity claim has been processed. first payment should arrive within 3 business days.
payload.follow_up_hint: no reply needed (noreply address). check that the deposit lands within 3 business days.

value.rationale: This is an automated notice that needs nothing from the parent, so a short digest note that the claim was processed and when payment is expected is enough.
